name: The Forgotten
notes: The lost Vesperines: skeletons of monks and miners who walked into the song (story bible §3.4, §8). They are allies of each other, so a swing or an arrow from one never hurts another (mw-qfx); fire, falling objects and other world damage still do. Toward the player they start hostile, as the unaligned default did before they had a faction, so their behaviour toward the player is unchanged. Neutral to every other faction except the Bridge Watch, which turns them away (see bridge-watch). The wider story relations are authored by mw-e13.17 and mw-e40.18.
